neutral.EN: Back off.
neutral.TL: Umatras ka.

neutral.EN: Step back right now.
neutral.TL: Lumayo ka ngayon din.

neutral.EN: Get out of my face.
neutral.TL: Umalis ka sa harap ko.

neutral.EN: Give me space before I lose my temper.
neutral.TL: Bigyan mo ako ng puwang bago ako magalit.

neutral.EN: Back away from me immediately.
neutral.TL: Lumayo ka sa akin agad-agad.

neutral.EN: I said back off.
neutral.TL: Sabi ko umatras ka.

neutral.EN: Keep your distance.
neutral.TL: Panatilihin ang distansya.

neutral.EN: Step back and cool down.
neutral.TL: Umatras ka at palamigin ang ulo.

neutral.EN: Back off while you still have the chance.
neutral.TL: Umatras ka habang may pagkakataon ka pa.

neutral.EN: Last warning: back off.
neutral.TL: Huling babala: umatras ka.

neutral.EN: You do not get to speak to me that way.
neutral.TL: Wala kang karapatang kausapin ako nang ganyan.

neutral.EN: Mind your mouth before someone breaks it for you.
neutral.TL: Bantayan ang bibig mo bago may bumasag niyan para sa 'yo.

neutral.EN: You don't talk to me with that disrespect.
neutral.TL: Huwag mo akong kausapin nang may pambabastos.

neutral.EN: Check your tone right now.
neutral.TL: Ayusin mo ang tono mo ngayon din.

neutral.EN: I won't tolerate that disrespect from anyone.
neutral.TL: Di ko palalampasin ang pambabastos na 'yan kahit kanino.

neutral.EN: Who do you think you're talking to?
neutral.TL: Sino sa tingin mo ang kinakausap mo?

neutral.EN: You have crossed a serious line with that mouth.
neutral.TL: Tumawid ka sa seryosong linya sa bibig mong 'yan.

neutral.EN: Watch how you address me.
neutral.TL: Bantayan mo kung paano mo ako kausapin.

neutral.EN: Lower your tone and show some basic respect.
neutral.TL: Hinaan ang tono at magpakita ng simpleng galang.

neutral.EN: You don't get to address me like that.
neutral.TL: Hindi mo ako pwedeng kausapin nang ganyan.
